title: Power Rankings: Mavs keep streak alive while Spurs overtake "selfish" Suns
heading: 2006-07 Power Rankings: Week 23
author: Marc Stein

rankings.summaryHtml: After those gaudy records they posted in January (14-2), February (10-0) and March (12-2), I don't quite know how to react to Mavs sitting at a mere 2-2 in April.
rankings.summaryText: After those gaudy records they posted in January (14-2), February (10-0) and March (12-2), I don't quite know how to react to Mavs sitting at a mere 2-2 in April.

rankings.summaryHtml: It's easier said than done, obviously, but Spurs' playoff foes are advised to find a way to score 100 points. SA is 1-10 this season when the opposition hits triple digits.
rankings.summaryText: It's easier said than done, obviously, but Spurs' playoff foes are advised to find a way to score 100 points. SA is 1-10 this season when the opposition hits triple digits.

rankings.summaryHtml: Seems like Spurs aren't Suns' only problem at present. Says Nash: ''The chemistry's not great. . . . We're a little bit selfish. We're a little bit woe-is-me right now.''
rankings.summaryText: Seems like Spurs aren't Suns' only problem at present. Says Nash: ''The chemistry's not great. . . . We're a little bit selfish. We're a little bit woe-is-me right now.''

rankings.summaryHtml: When Pistons win the Central -- their magic number is two -- it'll be their eighth division title in a span of 20 seasons. Since 1987-88, only Spurs (10) have won more.
rankings.summaryText: When Pistons win the Central -- their magic number is two -- it'll be their eighth division title in a span of 20 seasons. Since 1987-88, only Spurs (10) have won more.

rankings.summaryHtml: It just gets better and better for division-winning Raps, who even without their vital glue guy (Garbajosa) still can move up to the No. 2 seed after running over Bulls.
rankings.summaryText: It just gets better and better for division-winning Raps, who even without their vital glue guy (Garbajosa) still can move up to the No. 2 seed after running over Bulls.

rankings.summaryHtml: The way Bulls are going, at 17-7 since the All-Star break and 12-4 against fellow Central tenants, they haven't backed into the No. 2 seed. They've deservedly risen.
rankings.summaryText: The way Bulls are going, at 17-7 since the All-Star break and 12-4 against fellow Central tenants, they haven't backed into the No. 2 seed. They've deservedly risen.

rankings.summaryHtml: Despite losing three in a row at home -- first one to Utah, even -- and briefly losing T-Mac and Yao, Rockets are right there for a shot at home-court advantage in Round 1.
rankings.summaryText: Despite losing three in a row at home -- first one to Utah, even -- and briefly losing T-Mac and Yao, Rockets are right there for a shot at home-court advantage in Round 1.

rankings.summaryHtml: Can't decide if Jazz are playin' with fire or swimmin' with sharks, but we do know they're 1-7 in their last eight roadies and just lost at home to Allen-less Sonics.
rankings.summaryText: Can't decide if Jazz are playin' with fire or swimmin' with sharks, but we do know they're 1-7 in their last eight roadies and just lost at home to Allen-less Sonics.

rankings.summaryHtml: If the current seedings hold, Heat would face Cavs in Round 1 and Pistons in Round 2. Hardly ideal, but I suspect Cleveland and Detroit won't be any happier about it.
rankings.summaryText: If the current seedings hold, Heat would face Cavs in Round 1 and Pistons in Round 2. Hardly ideal, but I suspect Cleveland and Detroit won't be any happier about it.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cavs were the last East team with a shot to finish with a winning record on the road besides Pistons. But Sunday's loss in Detroit ruled out that possibility.
rankings.summaryText: Cavs were the last East team with a shot to finish with a winning record on the road besides Pistons. But Sunday's loss in Detroit ruled out that possibility.

rankings.summaryHtml: Talk about good timing. Before their crucial weekend wins over Mavs and Clips, Nuggets were -- no misprint -- a mere 1-24 when held below 100 points.
rankings.summaryText: Talk about good timing. Before their crucial weekend wins over Mavs and Clips, Nuggets were -- no misprint -- a mere 1-24 when held below 100 points.

rankings.summaryHtml: Lookie here: Warriors have won four of seven road games and played OK in the three losses (Lakers, Jazz, Spurs). They're now 11-4 with their first-choice team healthy.
rankings.summaryText: Lookie here: Warriors have won four of seven road games and played OK in the three losses (Lakers, Jazz, Spurs). They're now 11-4 with their first-choice team healthy.

rankings.summaryHtml: Pertinent question we might as well start considering now: If Clips hang onto a playoff spot sans Cassell and Livingston, who replaces them as Most Disappointing Team?

rankings.summaryHtml: The current 2-5 slump, with all five of the losses at Staples, would be causing more of a panic if Lakers didn't want to finish with the No. 7 seed and face Suns in Round 1.
rankings.summaryText: The current 2-5 slump, with all five of the losses at Staples, would be causing more of a panic if Lakers didn't want to finish with the No. 7 seed and face Suns in Round 1.

rankings.summaryHtml: Jefferson said recently that Nets had a four-game win streak left in them. If so, it'll include at least one W over their neighbors, with Knicks still on the schedule twice.
rankings.summaryText: Jefferson said recently that Nets had a four-game win streak left in them. If so, it'll include at least one W over their neighbors, with Knicks still on the schedule twice.

rankings.summaryHtml: It seems Peja won't be coming back, after all. Which means that banged-up Hornets' only salvation now might be more overtime games, since they're 6-0 in OT.
rankings.summaryText: It seems Peja won't be coming back, after all. Which means that banged-up Hornets' only salvation now might be more overtime games, since they're 6-0 in OT.

rankings.summaryHtml: Magic play four of their final six games on the road, as do Pacers. Magic haven't qualified for the playoffs since 2003, Pacers haven't missed them since 1997.
rankings.summaryText: Magic play four of their final six games on the road, as do Pacers. Magic haven't qualified for the playoffs since 2003, Pacers haven't missed them since 1997.

rankings.summaryHtml: Indy can no longer finish .500, true, but with their first back-to-back wins since mid-February and still holding the tiebreaker over Orlando, Pacers aren't dead yet.
rankings.summaryText: Indy can no longer finish .500, true, but with their first back-to-back wins since mid-February and still holding the tiebreaker over Orlando, Pacers aren't dead yet.

rankings.summaryHtml: It brings us no joy to heap more misery on Wiz, but the reality is that they were slipping before Butler and Arenas went down, going just 11-15 in February and March.

rankings.summaryHtml: Cheeks speak: ''I heard people saying we might be winning too many games.'' Our reaction after Sixers move to 14-9 since the break: Who ever used the word ''might?''

rankings.summaryHtml: Injuries are an undeniable factor in Knicks' 3-10 slide since Isiah got his extension. But their 3-10 record against fellow Atlantic Division residents? Unpardonable.

rankings.summaryHtml: Okafor's reactivation, coupled with Herrmann's elevation to key cog w/Wallace, sparks a 5-2 surge for Bobs . . . the first to score 100 vs. Miami in Heat's last 15 games.
rankings.summaryText: Okafor's reactivation, coupled with Herrmann's elevation to key cog w/Wallace, sparks a 5-2 surge for Bobs . . . the first to score 100 vs. Miami in Heat's last 15 games.

rankings.summaryHtml: The worst part? Now every win is a killer for KG's Wolves. Nine teams have worse records than they do and Wolves only keep their lottery pick if it's in the top 10.
rankings.summaryText: The worst part? Now every win is a killer for KG's Wolves. Nine teams have worse records than they do and Wolves only keep their lottery pick if it's in the top 10.

rankings.summaryHtml: Didn't see this coming: Sonics are a surprising 5-6 since Allen shut it down for their season . . . with two losses by three points or less and another L in overtime.
rankings.summaryText: Didn't see this coming: Sonics are a surprising 5-6 since Allen shut it down for their season . . . with two losses by three points or less and another L in overtime.

rankings.summaryHtml: Blazers' lead over Sonics in the race for regional pride is down to a half-game. A 6-20 record in April games since April '05, furthermore, suggests this isn't their month.

rankings.summaryHtml: The team Kings envy most? If they had Hornets' OT record, instead of their own 0-5 mark, Kings' run of eight straight trips to the playoffs wouldn't be ending.

rankings.summaryHtml: Sadly for the loyal few who follow Hawks, this ain't a new ending. Sunday's L in Philly dropped Atlanta's record since the All-Star break to 19-69 over the last three seasons.

rankings.summaryHtml: Krystkowiak is excused for losses now because it helps Bucks' draft odds. But fixing the D is job No. 1 next season: It has held only three teams under 90 points.

rankings.summaryHtml: Why so hard on NY for its 3-10 divisional record? Look at tanking Celts. Even in the midst of just the fifth 50-loss season in franchise history, they're 7-8 vs. Atlantic foes.

rankings.summaryHtml: After posting 50, 45 and 49 wins, this is not the sort of retro move that makes folks nostalgic: Grizz are one L shy of their fifth 60-loss season in 12 years of existence.
